notes.title: About next update and using inventory.
notes.content:
Hello all!
I hope all is well!
I am in the works of an update that I should be pushing out soon.
I got a few messages saying they were a little confused how to use the inventory system.
Sorry about that I should have added some kind of an explination.

Anyway hit your TAB button to free up the mouse this will allow you to
move the mouse to the top of the screen and this will drop down your inventory.
From there you can select any items you have picked up.
Hit the TAB button again and this will lock your mouse again and lock it to camera so you can move the camera normaly again.

When you are in the inventory just click an item and your mouse cursor will change to that item. The item can then be used on other items in the inventory if possible or used on items in the scene.

I hope this helps clear up any confusion.
In next update I will add an explination about this in game.
I am doing some optimizing along with smoothing out some gameplay and a few other
adjustments.

Any issues please message me or bring them up in these forums and I will get back to you asap!

Enjoy!

J.P.
